title: Affine open-closed gluing of coefficient-sized etale origin
statement: Let X be an affine scheme in universe u, i:Z→X a closed immersion, j:U→X a quasi-compact open immersion with range(j)=range(i)^c, A an arbitrary commutative ring in universe max v (u+1), and F a sheaf of A-modules on the coefficient-sized pro-etale site. Suppose i^*F and j^*F are in the essential image of the corresponding etale comparison inverse images. Then F is in the essential image over X. Use the comparison of [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism] and inverse images of [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image] on their equivalent coefficient-sized sites.

source.place: Tag 09AK, lemma-compare-constructible, proof; Zariski localization and open-closed induction

proof.text: Let eta:F→i_*i^*F be the unit of the canonical fixed-module adjunction. By [lem-pe-coefficient-origin-localization-kernel], eta is epic and its kernel has etale origin, using only the hypothesis on j^*F. The canonical kernel sequence ker eta→F→i_*i^*F is therefore short exact.
The hypothesis on i^*F and [lem-pe-coefficient-origin-closed-direct-image] put the right endpoint i_*i^*F in the comparison essential image.

Prove closure under extensions rather than restating it: [lem-pe-constructible-comparison-module-exact] makes intrinsic comparison exact; [lem-pe-coefficient-comparison-injective-acyclic] and the existing derived-adjunction acyclicity theorem make its bounded-below derived unit invertible. Lift the connecting map of the short exact sequence through this fully faithful derived functor, complete it to a triangle, and compare with the single-complex triangle of the sequence. Take zeroth homology: exact comparison commutes with homology, so H^0 of the lifted middle term is an antecedent of the given middle sheaf. Use the proved scalar equivalence of [lem-ctf-finite-comparison-model-realization]. The constant-section unit equation makes intrinsic and fixed-scalar direct image commute; conjugating this square through their adjunctions gives comparisonFixedLeft. This proved private isomorphism transports extension closure to fixed-module sheaves. Apply it to the canonical kernel sequence. No finite or Noetherian assumption is used.

proof_origin.place: Tags 09AH and 09AK, open-closed localization and extension argument; scalar-linear formulation with independent coefficient size. Closed direct image is proved by affine continuity and the classical module criterion. Derived extension closure is implemented explicitly in Lean.

    [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsOpenImmersion j] [QuasiCompact j]

    (F : Sheaf (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X)

      (Scheme.smallModelComparisonInclusion.{u, v} Z) (ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A)
      (Scheme.smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} Z)
      (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} Z)).essImage
      ((Scheme.coefficientProEtaleFixedModulePullback.{u, v} i A).obj F))
    (hj : (Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback
      (Scheme.smallModelComparisonInclusion.{u, v} U) (ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A)
      (Scheme.smallModelComparisonEtaleTopology.{u, v} U)
      (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} U)).essImage
      ((Scheme.coefficientProEtaleFixedModulePullback.{u, v} j A).obj F)) :
    (Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback
